Title: Public preview: Azure Migrate - SQL Server migration assessment for migration or modernization

Body.Content:
The new SQL discovery and assessment feature in Azure Migrate allow you to map your environment at-scale and assess readiness, cost, and blocks in moving these instances to Azure IaaS and PaaS. This feature presents the most viable and cost-effective Azure target for SQL instances. Additionally, this information can be downloaded into a report for presenting to decision makers. 

Learn more.
